recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Removing the commented legacy bullet would be optional source cleanup rather than a necessary specification correction.
issue_request: FHIR-17258 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 change request asking whether operations such as $validate could be invoked on a specific historical resource version endpoint like Patient/1/_history/4. The approved resolution removed support for operations on historical resource versions until a use case emerges.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 13893, mapped in git to d53fc1417c5b0fecc727dc1733c548ac2c07548b. That commit changed source/operations.html from four endpoint types to three by commenting out the specific-version endpoint bullet and added the ballot/history note that historical-resource operations were removed.
additional_context: The current operations source still says operations can be invoked on three endpoint types, and the only remaining _history operation bullet is inside the 2018 HTML comment. Current source searches found no active meta-add/meta-delete OperationDefinition in core and no operation invocation examples under _history version URLs. The history/delete-history material in source/http.html concerns RESTful history interactions rather than operations. Negative Zulip and Confluence searches found no later community evidence changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build source already implements the issue by limiting operations to base, type, and instance endpoints and not rendering historical-version operation support as current normative text.
